p.em: Internal components of qoomlee-service and payment-service

g.title: Tables: flights, routes, passengers, bookings, checkins, boarding_passes
Tables: payments
End user — searches flights, books seats, pays via Omise, checks in, views boarding pass.
HTTP layer — Search (GET /api/flights/search), GetByID (GET /api/flights/:id). Validates query params, converts BKK date → UTC range.
HTTP layer — Create (POST /api/bookings), GetByRef (GET /api/bookings/:ref), GetAll (GET /api/bookings), UpdateStatus (PUT /api/bookings/:ref/status).
Business logic — Search delegates to repo, enriches flights (price string + duration), ensures nil→[].
Business logic — Create (PNR gen, seat decrement with SELECT FOR UPDATE, bookingToken dedup), GetByRef (lazy expiry), UpdateStatus.
SQL layer — Search (JOIN flights + routes), GetByID. Uses scanner interface for shared scanFlight.
SQL layer — Create (INSERT booking + passenger in tx), GetByRef (JOIN flights + passengers + routes), GetAll, UpdateStatus.
SessionAuth (opaque Bearer token), InternalToken (X-Internal-Token for PUT /status), SecurityHeaders, CORS, CorrelationID, RequestLogger.
HTTP layer — Charge (POST /api/payments/charge), GetByBookingRef (GET /api/payments/:ref). Validates request body, maps errors to HTTP status.
Business logic — Charge (check duplicate, fetch booking, validate amount, call Omise, record result, confirm booking). GetByBookingRef.
SQL layer — Insert (INSERT INTO payments), GetByBookingRef (SELECT latest payment).
HTTP client — GET /api/bookings/:ref (fetch booking details), PUT /api/bookings/:ref/status (confirm after charge). Uses X-Internal-Token.
Omise SDK wrapper — CreateCharge (tokenize card + charge), returns ChargeResult (status, charge ID, failure code).
SessionAuth, RateLimit (10 req/s on charge), SecurityHeaders, CORS, CorrelationID, RequestLogger.
Search form (origin/destination autocomplete, date picker, passenger selector), search results (flight cards, sort), flight status.
Booking form (passenger details, validation), confirmation (PNR display, copy), my bookings (list, status badges), booking detail.
Omise card form, tokenization, amount display, success/error handling, countdown timer.
Check-in flow UI, boarding pass display (UI ready — backend QML-049–051 pending).
Login, register, profile management. Passport, contact, preferences.
AirportSelect (dropdown + bottom sheet), date range picker, travelers selector, cabin class selector, navigation shell.
5 test files: booking-token, flights-search, payment, traveller-booking-flow. Pages + fixtures + mocks pattern.
